segments.text: ALbeit that Good works, which are the Fruits of Faith, and follow after Juſtification, cannot put away our Sins, and endure the Severity of God's Judgment, yet are they pleaſing and acceptable to God in Chriſt, and do ſpring out neceſſarily of a true and lively Faith, inſomuch that by them a lively Faith may be as evidently known, as a tree diſcerned by the Fruit.
